responsibility: Declares the scope-block abstraction that partitions the quadruple stream into the contiguous ranges belonging to a module, inner module, definition, implementation, program body, or procedure. It exports creation and destruction of `ScopeBlock` lists and an iterator callback interface so later analyses and code generation can process one scope-owned quad range at a time.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition module for the M2Scope pair: it only publishes the opaque `ScopeBlock` type plus the `InitScopeBlock`, `KillScopeBlock`, and `ForeachScopeBlockDo` API. Unlike `M2Scope.mod`, it does not scan quadruples, classify scope kinds, or manage diagnostic scope entry/leave around iteration.
